next_action: Run a reviewed hosted compatibility check or an independently prepared source-provenance fixture against this exact commit; do not add further local schema polishing without a new counterexample.
completion_criterion: The exact candidate passes hosted or independent consumer review; legacy non-authoritative hashes remain stable, authoritative sources remain explicit and hash-bound, source-less authoritative evidence fails closed, proxy evidence remains non-authoritative and previous admission falsifiers remain at zero.
resume_trigger: Hosted compatibility result, independently prepared provenance fixture, identified external consumer or new serialization/source-loss counterexample.
